company.description: Florin is a full-stack insurance company with 0 underwriters. Software takes a submission from a raw intake form to a bindable quote in seconds. Instead of matching a business to a class code, it verifies what the business actually does using satellite imagery, permits, public records and social media, then prices it by simulating tens of thousands of ways its next few years could go.
